items.title: The Search Tax
items.summary: Your agents cannot know when they have enough context — nothing can, before the result arrives. What they can know is which game they are playing, and you decided that before they started. Five figures, two animations, a real itemised agent trace, and an open-source harness with predictions published before the results.

items.title: The Empty Window
items.summary: Context windows grew five thousandfold; the context an enterprise can supply did not move. Five sections, one argument: the missing half of enterprise knowledge, a weekend spent building the instrument to measure it, and where the whole claim could be wrong.

items.title: The Capability–Value Gap
items.summary: Intelligence may be the largest market ever created — but once models cross the sufficiency threshold, each extra unit of general intelligence buys less enterprise value. The advantage moves to the system around the model.

items.title: When Intelligence Gets Arms and Legs
items.summary: When AI stops answering and starts acting, advantage leaves the model. Follow the bottleneck, bound the blast radius, own the learning loop — and build the control plane that does all three.

items.title: The Amnesia Tax
items.summary: AI captures the answer and forgets the judgment behind it. The escape is a governed learning loop where decisions compound.

items.title: The Levels, Revisited for Agents
items.summary: The agentic era adds Trust and Memory to the old maturity test — the two dimensions that decide whether agents are more than demos.

items.title: Control Planes Are Becoming the New Cloud Regions
items.summary: Why the procurement unit of enterprise AI is shifting from models to the governed plane they run on — and who is positioned to own it.

items.title: The Levels of an AI-Pilled Organization
items.summary: Six levels, four diagnostic questions, public cases, and how to climb.

items.title: Why Trace-First Agent Systems Matter
items.summary: Serious teams evaluate agents at the trace level before they trust them — the same way auditors read ledgers, not summaries.

items.title: The Gap Is The Equation
items.summary: 80% of enterprises are building AI agents; 6% are getting results. Capacity is architecture × governance × knowledge.
